scope: Validate declared top-level agent inputs before processing begins.

behavior.required_fields: Missing required inputs fail before processing.
behavior.types: Declared primitive types are checked, with booleans excluded from integer/number values.
formats: UUID strings are parsed before database access.
Date strings must round-trip as exact YYYY-MM-DD values.
call_sites: Standalone AI summary and CIDS runners
EBF scorecard and calibration draft runners

verification.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_agent_tasks.py tests/test_agents_base.py tests/test_ai_summary_safety.py tests/test_agent_input_preflight.py tests/test_bio_factory_operations.py tests/test_capital_efficiency.py tests/test_commons_liberation.py tests/test_financial_resilience.py tests/test_gnh_alignment.py tests/test_holistic_wellbeing.py tests/test_kokonut_commons_governance.py tests/test_open_source_capitalist_scaling.py tests/test_regenerative_outcomes.py tests/test_cids_export.py tests/test_ebf_agents.py tests/test_delphi.py tests/test_agent_safety.py tests/test_ebf_agent_safety.py tests/test_ebf_calibration.py -q
verification.ruff: passed after removing a stale unused import

limitations: Shape validation does not authenticate an agent or authorize access to a location or object.
Nested input payloads are not recursively schema-validated.
The focused run does not establish authenticated agent identities, least-privilege database roles, populated task/provider parity, or runtime recovery.
